proof.dominance: Every infeasible state has H_QUBO >= 2 lambda > n+1 >= f_route* for a feasible route, so every global minimizer is feasible.
proof.feasible_upper_bound: A feasible route has n+1 directed arcs, each <=1, so f_route* <= n+1.
proof.minimum_positive_penalty: For an n x n binary matrix, if row/column one-hot constraints fail, conservation of total ones forces at least two unit squared deviations across the two families; exhaustive n=2,3,4 checks also give P_min=2.
proof.travel_nonnegative: All binary travel monomials have nonnegative coefficients because normalized directed costs are positive; therefore H_travel >= 0.
